blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-security-1 (Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Validate `name` where it enters (CWE-22): reject it unless it equals `os.path.basename(name)` and is not empty, `.` or `..`, and better, look it up in the `attachments` table for that `ticket_id` (the allow-list the upload already writes) before opening it. Additionally resolve the final path with `os.path.realpath` and check it stays under `os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, str(ticket_id))`. Add a test with `../1/x`, `../../../../etc/passwd` and `/etc/passwd`.
findings.title: Path traversal in read_attachment through the client-supplied name

findings.recommendation: Take the `agent_id` and check `may_read_ticket` (or a write-specific check) on the server before writing, as `read_attachment` does. Also refuse to overwrite an existing attachment of the same name, which currently replaces another agent's file silently.
findings.title: save_attachment performs no authorization check
